decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted plans, the existing construction and method of foprming the opening between the stairwell and the proposed lobby shall be completed in accordance with a scheme to be submitted to and approved by the LOcal Planning Authority before the relevant part of the works are commenced, including the following:
          (a) height of opening
          (b) doors, architraves
          (c) method of returning existing skirtings.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted plans, the existing door architrave, etc. between the proposed lounge diners shall be retained visually, in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the works are commenced.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted pl;ans, the proposed part closure and part removal of the wall between the existing staircase compartment and the proposed flat in No.13 shall be in accordance with a detailed scheme comprising a survey of the existing and details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the works are commenced, incorporating the following:
          (a) pier to be provided adjacent to the external wall to support beam over and as necessary to the intermediate position adjacent to the proposed doors.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted plans, the proposed replacement window shall be completed in accordance with a scheme to be first submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the works are commenced, such that it is subdivided in an appropriate manner.

Condition : 6 - Before the works hereby approved are commenced, a scheme demonstrating how the existing cornices, mouldings and other historic features including windows will be protected and retained during partitioning and other works shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be completed in accordance with such details.
description: Change of use of first floor of existing club to two-one bedroom self-contained flats.  (Listed Building Application)
